items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch
items.claim: The men of Israel shall pitch by their standards far from the tabernacle
items.actor: Every man of the children of Israel
items.place: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation
items.mechanism: by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house
